column1: # console-oracle cases: libkernel semaphores, mutexes and constant queries. Single-threaded sequences
# whose return codes (the SCE_KERNEL_ERROR_* values) are the point. Nothing here can block: no Wait
# calls, and a normal mutex is never locked twice. NULL pointer arguments are deliberately absent: the
# console's functions fault on them (SIGSEGV), so there is no behaviour to compare.
# Constant queries. The console's value is a per-unit calibration (about 1.6 GHz here) and prosper uses its
# own self-consistent frequency, so these two are recorded but not compared (expect=none).
# Semaphore lifecycle: initial 2, maximum 3. The handle value itself is not compared.
# Recursive mutex (type 2): nested locks succeed and each needs its own unlock.
# Error-checking mutex (type 1): relocking by the owner reports a deadlock instead of blocking.
